629:t_007:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to protect their song.」

629:t_007:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I feel... that I only truly learned what a song was after coming to Earth.」

629:t_007:6.en:
$$レド$$
「It isn't just a sequence of sounds or vibrations in the air... I think it's life itself.」

629:t_007:8.en:
$$レド$$
「And I... don't intend to fight those $$バジュラ$$ if we can understand one another.」

629:t_007:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ considers the $$バジュラ$$ a hostile species alongside the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

629:t_007:10.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm no longer a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. And the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ aren't really enemies either.」

629:t_007:11.en:
$$レド$$
「That's why I'll protect their song! I want to help them stop us fighting someone we don't need to fight!」

629:t_007:12.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't want... to feel what I felt with the $$クジライカ$$ ever again...」

629:t_007:14.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Now this is a surprise... $$レド$$ himself trying to communicate with creatures called $$バアル$$.」

629:t_007:16.en:
$$クラン$$
「You don't need to explain! You've spoken for all of us!」

629:t_007:17.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I rather like that wonderfully romantic way of thinking.」

629:t_007:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. I am no longer under the Alliance's control either.」

629:t_007:20.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will act according to the judgment of Ensign $$レド$$, the human being.」

629:t_007:22.en:
$$アル$$
「A partnership between human and machine. What a wonderful thing.」

629:t_007:23.en:
$$アル$$
「Above all, Ensign $$レド$$'s growth as a person never ceases to amaze me.」

629:t_007:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「For the record, I've reached the same decision as $$レド$$.」

629:t_007:25.en:
$$アル$$
「So have I. I cannot let anything spoil this rare duet by $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$.」

629:t_007:27.en:
$$アル$$
「Their songs are pleasant even to an AI such as myself.」

629:t_007:28.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm glad I lent you the $$シェリル$$ discs from my collection.」

629:t_007:29.en:
$$シモン$$
「Lending you my $$ランカ$$ discs was worth it too!」

629:t_007:30.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it! Let's protect $$ランカ$$ and the others' song!」

629:t_007:31.en:
$$木下$$
「Yes! The $$銀河の妖精$$ and the $$超時空シンデレラ$$ are symbols of our hope!」

629:t_008:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You aren't the only one who believes in what you're trying to do.」

629:t_008:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You're the First $$イノベイター$$. We could call you the forerunner of a new era in $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

629:t_008:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Young man... You truly do show me the way.)

629:t_008:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Let's do this, $$刹那$$. We'll bring this situation under control and make contact with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

629:t_008:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's my mission... my mission as an $$イノベイター$$...!」

629:t_009:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I confirm that all $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and $$バジュラ$$ have been destroyed.」

629:t_009:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're saved. We couldn't have kept fighting much longer...」

629:t_009:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「There's the damage to the pilots, but our machines are also badly worn down from the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

629:t_009:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$スメラギ$$! More $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ confirmed approaching! There are $$バジュラ$$ too!」

629:t_010:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Are you serious!? There's a limit to everything!」

629:t_010:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「We have to take on this huge swarm...?」

629:t_010:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Summon every ounce of willpower! If we retreat here, the main $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ force will reach Earth and the colonies!」

629:t_010:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Easy for you to say! But this is just...!」

629:t_011:1.en:
$$シェリル$$
(If the $$バジュラ$$ and $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ live in symbiosis, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ must have minds too...)

629:t_011:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Please, $$バジュラ$$... Listen to our song, and then...)

629:t_012:0.en:
$$レド$$
「This is bad! They're targeting the $$クォーター$$!」

629:t_012:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do we have no choice but to fight!?」

629:t_012:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Please understand, $$バジュラ$$... We... don't want to fight you...)

629:t_013:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Did their song reach them?」

629:t_014:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll use the $$ライザーシステム$$ to create a shared consciousness field with high-density GN particles!」

629:t_014:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ has its limits...!」

629:t_015:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Here goes! $$トランザムバースト$$!」

629:t_016:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I'm counting on you, $$刹那$$. Everything depends on your dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...!)

629:t_018:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ is being assimilated by the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

629:t_018:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This is bad! $$刹那$$ is unconscious!」

629:t_019:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Don't, $$ティエリア$$! If you use $$脳量子波$$ there...!」

629:t_019:1.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「You'll be the one the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...!」

629:t_020:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You idiot, $$ティエリア$$! Are you planning to sacrifice yourself!?」

629:t_020:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't worry about me! Please save $$刹那$$!」

629:t_021:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「For dialogue...! For humanity's future, I can't let them kill $$刹那$$!」
